🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-08-26 23:00 → 2026-08-27 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **ERC-8354 reached upstream merge** — a co-authored ERC cleared upstream, turning shared drafting effort into a concrete milestone the whole group can build on. [tg:tawg:3450]

> **dex-calldata-v0 hermetic gate landed** — a conformance gap that had spec and test vectors but no automated check is now closed in recompute-kit. [PR #15](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/15)

> **pq-agent-binding v1 PR opened** — a key design question was settled: governs_from is derived from context, never stored, keeping bindings leaner and auditable. [PR #1](https://github.com/trustless-ai/pq-agent-binding/pull/1)

> **RVR surfaced as a pre-ERC interoperability proposal** — Recomputable Verification Receipts now has a defined scope: making verification results independently portable across agents. [tg:tawg:3470]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8354

_A successful upstream merge created momentum for both celebrating the milestone and scoping what follows._

- Zidan (@mzf11125) **Shared** the next ERC in development with Zexo and previous co-authors, giving the group early visibility into where the collaboration is heading and a chance to engage before the draft matures. [tg:tawg:3448]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Recognized** ERC-8354's upstream merge and immediately opened a path forward by welcoming a follow-up PR to align the agent-ercs Domain shape, bridging the milestone into actionable next work. [tg:tawg:3450]

### recompute-kit

_Conformance coverage deepened across multiple parallel tracks inside recompute-kit._

- Zexo **Shipped** a hermetic conformance gate for dex-calldata-v0, filling a gap where the module had spec and vectors but no automated guard, which directly strengthens the kit's reliability guarantees. [PR #15](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/15)
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Shared** a conformance commit for the integrations path, providing reviewers with a concrete artifact that keeps integration coverage advancing in step with spec progress. [tg:tawg:3454]
- Merlini **Opened** a PR adding an owner-neutral binding-record registry with schema and semantics, removing an ownership-bias concern from the serializer-bindings conformance surface. [PR #24](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/24)
- Pavlo **Confirmed** that the chain logic in PR #25 is correct and the two required negative cases are now genuinely executable, unblocking the PR from its key correctness question. [comment on PR #25](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/25#issuecomment-5445698300)

### ERC-8004 / ERC-8373

_Live spec discussion and attribution transparency kept reviewer input grounded in real numbers and shared norms._

- Baby Blue Viper **Engaged** on the ERC-8004 Magicians thread with concrete settlement data, noting that the split between resolved and unresolved cases is exactly the kind of grounding the spec needs to move forward. [post 387](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/387)
- Merlini (@gobross) **Raised** the ERC-8373 attribution question openly, noting that two reviewers made meaningful improvements to the failure semantics and inviting the group to decide together rather than unilaterally. [tg:tawg:3488]

### TSEI / RVR

_External proposal review and terminology clarity gave the group stronger shared context for verifiable AI output work._

- Damon Zwicker (@damonzwicker) **Read** the TSEI DOI candidate in full and highlighted the honesty machinery — three evidence layers kept separate with n=1 stated upfront — as the part most worth pointing new readers toward. [tg:tawg:3452]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Defined** RVR as Recomputable Verification Receipts, a pre-ERC interoperability proposal for making verification results independently portable, giving the group a cleaner shared definition to build from. [tg:tawg:3470]

### tooling

_A bot usability fix removed friction that slowed contributors when requests fell outside scope._

- Jimmy Shi **Opened** a PR replacing the bot's generic out-of-scope refusal with actionable guidance, so contributors get clearer next steps instead of a dead end. [PR #5](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/pull/5)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Explore how RVR's portability goal fits alongside current recompute-kit conformance coverage
- Consider how the pq-agent-binding governs_from derivation approach relates to broader ERC binding semantics
- Watch whether the ERC-8373 attribution discussion surfaces a norm the group wants to codify

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Review pq-agent-binding v1 PR and weigh in on the governs_from design choice
- Follow up on ERC-8354 with a Domain shape alignment PR for agent-ercs
- Resolve ERC-8373 attribution collaboratively before the next review cycle

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** An ERC landed upstream and within minutes the team had already named the next one and mapped the follow-up PR — zero cool-down time between "shipped" and "what's next."
>
> When "done" is just the group's shorthand for "ready to hand off," the whole relay runs faster. Keep that baton flying! 🏃
